description: Distretto Po - Autorita di bacino del fiume Po (ITN008) - FHRM - Direttiva Alluvioni - Mappe di pericolosita da alluvione 2013 - scenari di bassa, media e alta probabilita is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by adbpo.it. Flood Hazard and Risk Maps (FHRM), Hazard and Risk Maps in the Po River Basin provided for in Directive 2007/60/EC, containing the delimitation of hazard areas for low, medium and high probability scenarios and for various return times and associated information on the elements involved: population, IED facilities, economic activities, cultural heritage and landscape ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Po District — Po River Basin Authority (ITN008) — FHRM — Floods Directive — 2013 Flood Hazard Maps — Low, medium and hig" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
